title: The Pallet Bar
subtitle: A backyard bar out of salvaged pallets

chapters.title: Choose the Pallet, Skip the Cut
chapters.blurb: A specification instead of a saw: four salvage candidates measured against 47 by 40 inches with six-inch boards, until one survives and tips up into the bar face.

chapters.title: Two Cuts Make a U
chapters.blurb: Two side pallets trimmed to two feet, spun so their raw cut ends face front, and screwed home into a U that will not fall over.

chapters.title: The Top That Ties It Together
chapters.blurb: Where the 65-inch top comes from, why it hangs eight inches out front, and how a lid turns a wobbly U into a rigid box.

chapters.title: Three Coats and a Level Patio
chapters.blurb: Stain is colour, not armour: three coats into the grain, a film of Varathane on the top, and level patio stone underneath.
